title: Warm Silky Japanese Kabocha Oyakodon
description: A citrusy and silky Japanese dish featuring kabocha, perfect for a brunch mood, with a wood-fired bake and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, mirin, and yuzu juice.
Add the cubed kabocha squash to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Spread the kabocha squash on a baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt.
Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Pour the eggs into the skillet and scramble them until they are almost set.
Add the cooked Japanese rice to the skillet and stir to combine with the eggs.
To assemble the oyakodon, place a portion of the egg and rice mixture into a bowl, then top with the roasted kabocha squash and green onions.
